question: What is the median of the average monthly projected sales in USD for France in 2021, calculated by using the monthly sales data from 2019 and 2020 (filtered by promo_total_id=1 and channel_total_id=1), applying the growth rate from 2019 to 2020 to project 2021, converting to USD based on the currency table, and then determining the monthly averages before finding their median?
sql:
WITH monthly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_month_desc,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_amount,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.calendar_month_desc LIKE '2019-%' THEN '2019'
            WHEN t.calendar_month_desc LIKE '2020-%' THEN '2020'
            ELSE 'other'
        END as year,
        SUBSTRING(t.calendar_month_desc, 1, 4) as year_prefix,
        SUBSTRING(t.calendar_month_desc, 6, 2) as month_num
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52779
      AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
      AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
      AND t.calendar_month_desc IN ('2019-01', '2019-02', '2019-03', '2019-04', '2019-05', '2019-06', 
                                     '2019-07', '2019-08', '2019-09', '2019-10', '2019-11', '2019-12',
                                     '2020-01', '2020-02', '2020-03', '2020-04', '2020-05', '2020-06',
                                     '2020-07', '2020-08', '2020-09', '2020-10', '2020-11', '2020-12')
    GROUP BY t.calendar_month_desc, year, year_prefix, month_num
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        '2021-' || s2020.month_num as calendar_month_desc,
        s2020.total_amount as sales_2020,
        s2019.total_amount as sales_2019,
        s2020.total_amount + ((s2020.total_amount - s2019.total_amount) / s2019.total_amount) * s2020.total_amount as projected_2021
    FROM monthly_data s2020
    JOIN monthly_data s2019 ON s2020.month_num = s2019.month_num
    WHERE s2020.year = '2020' AND s2019.year = '2019'
)
SELECT * FROM projected_2021 ORDER BY calendar_month_desc
